<h3 class="publication-title">
Welche Faktoren erklären Wahlbeteiligung?
Ein Vergleich erklärender statistischer mit explorativen
Machine-Learning Ansätzen am Beispiel der Bundestagswahl 2017
</h3>

<p class="publication-author">Martin Preiß</p>

<p class="publication-affiliation">
Department of Political Science · University of Freiburg
</p>

<hr>

<h4>Abstract</h4>

<p>
This thesis examines voter turnout in the 2017 German
federal election using data from the GESIS Panel Core
Studies. A theory-driven logistic regression model with
12 predictors is compared with two exploratory machine
learning models, Random Forest and XGBoost, trained on
222 predictors.
</p>

<p>
All three models identify previous electoral participation,
voting norms and political interest as central predictors.
Machine learning additionally reveals patterns related to
media consumption and political trust, while offering modest
improvements in predictive performance. The findings highlight
the complementary role of explanatory and predictive
modelling in political science.
</p>
